title: Two arms over the belt
subtitle: 2 x UR5e + 2F-85, humanoid mount, head camera
summary: A humanoid-style sorting cell: two UR5e + 2F-85 mounted on the sides of a torso at shoulder height (each arm's base axis pointing outward), the conveyor from the conveyor example in front, and a D435-class colour camera in the head looking down at the belt. The arms come calibrated from the bench (the UR5e + 2F-85 example); this is the deployment calibration: where each arm is really mounted, and the head camera's intrinsics and pose, from tags on the grippers and on the belt.

model.source: Menagerie ur5e + 2f85 (bam_arm.cell's attach) x 2, sysid's conveyor.xml, one MuJoCo camera

cameras.name: head_camera
cameras.source: a D435 colour stream at 640 x 480 (intel_rgbd's sensor contract), as a MuJoCo fovy camera
